description: Installation of external lighting to the front entrance and front basement lightwell, along with an entry touch panel and proximity reader at the entrance.
reference_no_of_permission_being_relied_:
23/02367/LBC - Internal alterations at all levels to accommodate office refurbishment, installation of 4 x heat pump units and photovoltaic panels at roof level, replacement of rear basement rooms and single-storey extension to the rear ground floor to extend existing office use, reconstruction of existing WC closet extension at mid-first/second-floor level, replacement of existing window sashes with double-glazed timber sashes, external repairs to the building and associated works, all in connection with continued office use.

24/02207/LBC - Relocation of the WC within the reconstructed closet extension at middle, first and second floor level to improve the comfort facilities located on the third floor and change the use of the reconstructed closet extension from WC to office. Rearranging the layout of comfort facilities at third floor, removing direct access between the office and comfort facilities, incorporating the WC from the closet extension into the comfort facilities at third floor and relocating the tea point into the office space (Linked 24/01715/NMA).

25/02792/LBC - Internal alterations to third floor. 

26/01486/LBC - Replacement of the structurally failing front basement lightwell wall, with repair and reinstatement of railings and plinth stones; the introduction of a concealed structural backing wall (Stepoc blocks reinforced with concrete) and a lime-bedded reclaimed brick-facing wall
